Flute.name: Long Tones
Flute.description: Focus on relaxed posture and steady airflow. Play low F, E, D, C.

Flute.name: Breathing
Flute.description: Slow 4-count inhale, controlled 8-count exhale. Keep air unforced.

Clarinet.name: Long Tones
Clarinet.description: Focus on a firm embouchure and relaxed shoulders. Low E to chalumeau register.

Clarinet.name: Breathing
Clarinet.description: Slow 4-count inhale, controlled 8-count exhale. Support from diaphragm.

Trumpet.name: Buzzing
Trumpet.description: Buzz on mouthpiece only. Match pitch with a piano if possible.

Trumpet.name: Long Tones
Trumpet.description: Play low C, B, Bb, A, Ab, G, Gb, F. Maintain steady air.

Violin.name: Open Strings
Violin.description: Bow open strings G, D, A, E. Focus on straight bow and relaxed grip.

Violin.name: Scales
Violin.description: Play G major scale 2 octaves slowly. Intonation focus.

Piano.name: Hanon 1
Piano.description: Play Hanon exercise 1 slowly, focusing on curved fingers and relaxed wrists.

Piano.name: Scales
Piano.description: C, G, D major scales 2 octaves, hands together.

Default.name: General Warmup
Default.description: Long tones or basic scales to get your fingers and breath moving.

Default.name: Breathing & Posture
Default.description: Check your posture, do a 4-in 8-out breathing exercise.
